about: The AP Macroeconomics app pages. scripts/build-apmacro.mjs writes each page's shell (head, header, footer, a <div id="app"> mount) from this file; the page's behavior is its script in macroeconomics/assets/<script>, which mounts into #app. "static": true marks a generated page that is not an app (teachers.html). premium names the Premium feature (ApMacroCore gates it); card is the line on the course home. No path may contain the token "ap" (docs/apmacro-spec.md decision 2). tools[] are the eight trainers of docs/apmacro-spec.md section 6, pre-registered in Phase 0: page macroeconomics/tools/<slug>.html, script macroeconomics/assets/tools/<slug>.js, model macroeconomics/assets/tools/math/<slug>.js (ApMacroMath.<camelSlug>), content macroeconomics/data/tools/<slug>.json, validator scripts/lib/apmacro-tool-checks/<slug>.mjs, test scripts/test/apmacro-tool-<slug>.test.mjs (docs/apmacro-architecture.md, "Tools"). topic is the tool's context topic: the tool is built only when its data file exists and that topic is published. FREE OR PREMIUM is set here and only here: a tool with "premium": "tools" is Premium; graph-studio, ppc-trade and indicators-lab carry none and are free (docs/apmacro-spec.md section 6, proposed; owner to confirm).

apps.title: Practice questions
apps.desc: Macroeconomics practice by unit, topic or skill: graphs to shift and label, calculations, data and scenario sets, and causal chains made specific.
apps.card: Drill a unit, a topic or a skill, with graphs to shift, calculations and data sets.

apps.title: Spaced review
apps.desc: Your macroeconomics spaced review queue: every question you missed comes back just before you would forget it.
apps.card: Missed questions come back when you are about to forget them.

apps.title: Exams
apps.desc: Timed macroeconomics unit tests and full practice exams in the May 2027 format: 60 multiple-choice questions, then three free-response questions.
apps.card: Unit tests and full timed practice exams in the May 2027 format.

apps.title: Free-response practice
apps.desc: Macroeconomics free-response practice: long and short questions with graphs you draw on the page, a point-by-point rubric and a full-credit sample.
apps.card: One long and two short questions, with rubrics, graphs you draw on the page and sample answers.

apps.title: Make it specific
apps.desc: Macroeconomics written answers made specific enough to score: causal chains with every link, the right tool, the right curve and the multiplier the right way.
apps.lede: Write the answer, then check it against the rubric and two model answers: one that earns the point and one that loses it.
apps.card: Causal chains with every link, the right tool and the right curve, checked against a rubric.

apps.title: Cram kit
apps.desc: Macroeconomics cram plans counted back from your exam date: three or two weeks, day by day, weighted by unit, with timed sets and practice exams.
apps.lede: A 3-week or 2-week plan counted back from your exam date, day by day: unit sheets and notes, a timed mixed set and one free-response question each study day, two full practice exams and rest days. Print it and tick the days off.
apps.card: 3-week and 2-week plans to exam day, and timed mixed sets.

apps.title: Flashcards
apps.desc: Spaced-repetition macroeconomics flashcards built from the glossary and the formulas you must know, by unit and topic.
apps.card: Spaced-repetition cards from the glossary and the formulas.

apps.title: Tools
apps.desc: Macroeconomics trainers: the graph studio, PPC and trade, indicators, multipliers, AD-AS, reserves, policy chains and foreign exchange.
apps.card: Trainers and simulators, then the questions about what you saw.

apps.title: Progress
apps.desc: Your macroeconomics mastery by unit, topic and skill, with every miss linked to the lesson that teaches it.
apps.card: Mastery by unit, topic and skill.

apps.title: Search the course
apps.desc: Search every macroeconomics lesson, notes page, glossary term and tool in the course.

apps.title: For teachers
apps.desc: For macroeconomics teachers: stable share links, printable notes and unit sheets, and Google Classroom sharing, with no new student data collected.
apps.lede: Share any notes page, lesson or unit sheet with a stable link. Students need no account, and nothing they do leaves their device unless they choose to sign in.

tools.name: Graph studio
tools.title: Graph Studio
tools.desc: All nine graphs drawn, labeled and shifted by hand, graded point by point the way readers score them, with the slip named.
tools.blurb: Draw, label and shift all nine graphs, graded per rubric point.
tools.lede: Shift the curve, mark the new equilibrium, see what the reader sees.

tools.name: PPC and trade
tools.title: PPC and Trade Trainer
tools.desc: PPC shapes and shifts, opportunity cost, comparative advantage from output and input data, and terms of trade that help both sides.
tools.blurb: Opportunity cost, comparative advantage and terms of trade.
tools.lede: Find who gives up less, then trade on terms that help both.

tools.name: Indicators lab
tools.title: Economic Indicators Lab
tools.desc: GDP by expenditure, CPI and inflation, the deflator, real versus nominal, and unemployment types and rates, each calculation checked step by step.
tools.blurb: GDP, CPI, inflation, the deflator and unemployment rates.
tools.lede: Every indicator calculated and read the way the exam asks.

tools.name: Multiplier lab
tools.title: Multiplier Lab
tools.desc: Spending, tax and balanced-budget multipliers, closing a gap with the direction first and the gap divided, and the money multiplier.
tools.blurb: Spending, tax and money multipliers, and closing a gap.
tools.lede: Direction first, then divide the gap by the right multiplier.

tools.name: AD-AS lab
tools.title: AD-AS Lab
tools.desc: Short-run shocks to aggregate demand and supply and the long-run self-adjustment with its cause, linked to the Phillips curve.
tools.blurb: Shocks, gaps and self-adjustment on the AD-AS graph.
tools.lede: Shock the economy, then watch wages and SRAS bring it back.

tools.name: Reserves lab
tools.title: Bank Reserves Lab
tools.desc: Ample versus limited reserves: the reserve market and the money market side by side, and every Federal Reserve tool, each with its effect on rates and output.
tools.blurb: Ample and limited reserves, and every Fed tool.
tools.lede: Move the administered rate and see what the policy rate does.

tools.name: Policy chain
tools.title: Policy Chain Builder
tools.desc: Build the causal chain link by link for fiscal, monetary and open-economy shocks, each link graded, so no step gets skipped.
tools.blurb: Causal chains for every policy, link by link.
tools.lede: Every link named, from the policy to the price level.

tools.name: Forex lab
tools.title: Foreign Exchange Lab
tools.desc: Currency axes the right way round, demand and supply shifts, appreciation and depreciation, net exports and capital flows.
tools.blurb: Currency markets, appreciation, net exports and capital flows.
tools.lede: Read the axis right, shift the right curve, follow the money.
